a1.title: German Vocabulary A1
a1.intro: German Vocabulary A1 is the first step for beginners learning the language.

levelExplanation.heading: What does A1 level mean in German?
levelExplanation.paragraph: The A1 level corresponds to the beginner stage according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). Learners can understand and use familiar expressions and very basic phrases for concrete needs.

vocabularyScope.heading: What does German Vocabulary A1 include?

groups.heading: Everyday communication
items: Numbers, days of the week, and months
Common verbs in the present tense

wordCount.heading: How many words are in German Vocabulary A1?
wordCount.text: The A1 level typically includes around 500–800 essential words. The goal is not just memorization, but using words actively in simple sentences. Regular German vocabulary exercises A1 help consolidate learning.

a1.metaTitle: German Vocabulary A1 – Essential Words for Beginners
a1.metaDescription: Learn German Vocabulary A1 with essential words and simple examples. Build a solid foundation to start speaking and understanding German.
introParagraphs: German Vocabulary A1 is the first step for beginners learning the language. At this level, you learn simple words and expressions to communicate in everyday situations.

Basic German words A1 include greetings, numbers, common verbs, and simple questions. Using a well-structured German vocabulary list A1 helps expand your vocabulary gradually and gain confidence in communication.

bottomCta.heading: Start learning now
bottomCta.text: Knowing German Vocabulary A1 provides a solid foundation. Practice regularly, use words in simple sentences, and listen to short dialogues to strengthen your skills.

a2.title: German Vocabulary A2
a2.intro: German Vocabulary A2 expands on the knowledge gained at A1.

levelExplanation.heading: What does A2 level mean in German?
levelExplanation.paragraph: The A2 level corresponds to elementary proficiency. Learners can understand frequently used expressions and interact in simple, routine tasks.

vocabularyScope.heading: What does German Vocabulary A2 include?

wordCount.heading: How many words are in German Vocabulary A2?
wordCount.text: A2 usually includes 1,000–1,500 useful words. Regular practice helps consolidate vocabulary and improve fluency.

a2.metaDescription: Learn German Vocabulary A2 with common words and practical examples. Improve comprehension and communication at the elementary level.
introParagraphs: German Vocabulary A2 expands on the knowledge gained at A1. At this stage, learners can form longer sentences and communicate more fluently in everyday situations.
Everyday German vocabulary covers topics like work, leisure, travel, and health. A well-structured German vocabulary list A2 helps learners gradually master new words effectively.

bottomCta.heading: Continue your studies
bottomCta.text: German Vocabulary A2 allows more independent communication. Read simple texts, listen to dialogues, and review new words regularly.

b1.title: German Vocabulary B1
b1.intro: German Vocabulary B1 represents the intermediate stage.

levelExplanation.heading: What does B1 level mean in German?
levelExplanation.paragraph: The B1 level corresponds to independent use of German at an intermediate stage. Learners can handle most everyday situations and produce simple but coherent texts.

vocabularyScope.heading: What does German Vocabulary B1 include?

wordCount.heading: How many words are in German Vocabulary B1?
wordCount.text: B1 usually includes 2,000–3,000 words. To expand German B1 vocabulary, it is recommended to read articles, listen to podcasts, and practice speaking regularly.

b1.metaDescription: Learn German Vocabulary B1 with intermediate words and detailed examples. Improve your expression and comprehension in German.
introParagraphs: German Vocabulary B1 represents the intermediate stage. Learners can understand the main points of clear messages and express themselves in more detail.

Intermediate German words B1 allow expressing opinions, sharing experiences, and participating in more complex conversations. A well-structured German vocabulary list B1 helps expand your vocabulary and strengthen your skills.

bottomCta.heading: Strengthen your intermediate level
bottomCta.text: With a solid German Vocabulary B1, you can communicate clearly and structured. Practice regularly, discuss current topics, and read more complex texts to deepen your vocabulary.

b2.title: German Vocabulary B2
b2.intro: German Vocabulary B2 is designed for learners who can already communicate fluently and want to handle more complex topics.

levelExplanation.heading: What does B2 level mean?
levelExplanation.paragraph: At B2 level, you can interact spontaneously with native speakers. German words level B2 include abstract terms, logical connectors, and expressions useful for debates or professional settings.
bullets: Understanding main ideas of complex texts.
Expressing and defending opinions in a structured way.
Using varied connectors to organize speech.

groups.heading: Discussion and argumentation
items: Terms for analyzing problems and solutions.

groups.heading: Work and society
items: Words related to work and education.
Formal expressions for reports and emails.

wordCount.heading: How many words at B2?
wordCount.text: The B2 German vocabulary usually includes several thousand active words. What matters most is the ability to use them correctly in writing and speaking.

b2.metaTitle: German Vocabulary B2 – Key Words and Phrases
b2.metaDescription: Expand your German vocabulary B2 with essential words, meanings, and examples to communicate confidently in everyday and professional contexts.
introParagraphs: German Vocabulary B2 is designed for learners who can already communicate fluently and want to handle more complex topics. At this level, you can participate in discussions and express your thoughts clearly.

Intermediate German vocabulary helps you build arguments, evaluate advantages and disadvantages, and understand longer and more complex texts. The focus is on improving accuracy and fluency in communication.

bottomCta.heading: Keep expanding your vocabulary
bottomCta.text: To master German B2 vocabulary, read texts, listen to debates, and practice speaking and writing. Active use consolidates newly learned words.

c1.title: German Vocabulary C1
c1.intro: German Vocabulary C1 corresponds to an advanced level where you master complex expressions and abstract terms.

levelExplanation.heading: Features of C1 level
levelExplanation.paragraph: German words level C1 include specialized terms, formal expressions, and varied logical connectors.
bullets: Fluent, structured expression of abstract ideas.

groups.heading: Academic language
items: Words related to research and critical thinking.

groups.heading: Professional communication
items: Formal expressions for reports and documents.
Precise verbs for argumentation and negotiation.

wordCount.heading: How many words at C1?
wordCount.text: German C1 vocabulary typically contains several thousand active words. The key is to use them accurately and fluently.

c1.metaDescription: Enhance your German vocabulary C1 with advanced words, examples, and explanations for precise and nuanced communication.
introParagraphs: German Vocabulary C1 corresponds to an advanced level where you master complex expressions and abstract terms. You can understand long texts and communicate accurately and spontaneously.
Advanced German vocabulary allows you to analyze, argue, and use nuanced language in academic or professional contexts. The goal is to expand your lexicon while maintaining appropriate register.

bottomCta.heading: Advance your German skills
bottomCta.text: To master C1 German vocabulary, read complex texts, participate in debates, and write structured essays. Regular practice improves accuracy and confidence.

c2.title: German Vocabulary C2
c2.intro: German Vocabulary C2 represents full mastery of the language according to CEFR.

levelExplanation.heading: Features of C2 level
levelExplanation.paragraph: German words level C2 cover academic, literary, and technical fields with emphasis on subtle meaning differences.
bullets: Precise use of synonyms with nuanced distinctions.
Perfect adaptation to formal or informal register.

wordCount.heading: How many words at C2?
wordCount.text: German C2 vocabulary may exceed 6,000 active words. True mastery is measured by the ability to use them naturally and accurately.

c2.metaTitle: German Vocabulary C2 – Complete Language Mastery
c2.metaDescription: Discover German vocabulary C2 with rare, precise words and expressions to achieve complete mastery of the language.
introParagraphs: German Vocabulary C2 represents full mastery of the language according to CEFR. You understand virtually everything you read or hear and can express yourself with precision, nuance, and spontaneity.
Highly advanced German vocabulary includes rare terms, idiomatic expressions, and stylistic subtleties. It allows perfect adaptation of speech to any context.

bottomCta.heading: Achieve complete mastery
bottomCta.text: To master German C2 vocabulary, read literary works, attend specialized lectures, and write complex texts. Intensive and varied practice is essential to consolidate linguistic excellence.
